description: Electricity Demand and Weather Data (2021–2023) is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Lei Xing. This dataset contains hourly electricity demand data and corresponding weather indicators collected from 2021 to 2023. The electricity data was sourced from the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), covering both winter and summer periods across three years. Weather features (including temperature, wind speed, and humidity) were collected to capture the external conditions affecting demand. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
